html: Our preprint "Physical Agentic AI: An Architecture for Orchestrating a Robot Crew with LLMs" is on arXiv; an abridged version appears at the IROS'26 Workshop on Foundation Models in Multi-Robot Systems.
Reviewing for NeurIPS'26, CoRL'26 and IROS'26, and for the WiML Workshop at NeurIPS'26 and an IROS'26 workshop.
Our paper "CUPID in the Model Zoo: Online Matchmaking for Selecting Your Dream LLM" was accepted to ICML'26.
Our paper "LLM Routing as Reasoning: A MaxSAT View" was accepted to the ICLR'26 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models.
Our preprint "Cognitive Models as Evaluation Primitives in Humanoid Factors" is on arXiv; an abridged version appears at the ICLR'26 Workshop on From Human Cognition to AI Reasoning.
Joined Arizona State University as a PhD student in Computer Science, advised by Prof. Ransalu Senanayake.
Our paper "Neural-Augmented Kelvinlet for Real-Time Soft Tissue Deformation Modeling" was accepted to AAAI'25.
